purpose: Familiar Season 2 icons: glass and reed goods, Bram's shelf and till, Mochi's purse and wish token

generator.tool: Codex CLI codex-cli 0.169.0 (`codex exec`, image generation tool)

delivery: WebP renditions produced by scripts/optimize-season-assets.ts (see manifest.json). Masters are 1024x1024 PNG on a cream backdrop that is not pixel-exact; the cream is removed by corner flood fill.

glass.webp.prompt: Create one square 1024x1024 PNG game asset for the cozy harbor game Familiar: glass.png. Subject: one small rounded translucent teal-green sea-glass pebble, a chunky irregular chunk with softly frosted edges, crafted as a handmade felt-and-wool stop-motion miniature with visible fine fibres while retaining a gentle glasslike translucency. Match the attached Bram, lens, moth, and shell references in handmade materials, soft warm studio lighting, gentle chunky shapes, and warm muted coastal colors (sea-glass teal, sand, cream, weathered wood brown, brass). Center and isolate the single object on a plain flat solid cream background, exact color #efe4cc, with only a soft contact shadow. Object fills about 70% of the frame with generous clear margins and a silhouette readable at 48px. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI frames, scenery, extra objects, or border.
